text: The Quantum Clock Is Ticking reports resource estimates indicating that elliptic-curve cryptography used by major blockchains may be breakable with fewer quantum resources than previously believed. This independently supplies a concrete threat mechanism corresponding to Kaal's requirement for quantum-resistant cryptography. The abstract does not show that any blockchain has been broken or independently validate the estimates beyond its reported method.
